Container.Name: rom-archiver
Container.Overview: ROM Archiver — A Steam-like frontend for your local ROM library. Features IGDB metadata, cover art, No-Intro/Redump hash verification, and one-click downloads.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the ROM Archiver web interface.

Config.Name: ROM Library
Config.Description: Path to your ROM library. Subfolders are auto-detected as platforms (e.g. /roms/n64/, /roms/snes/).

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Path for persistent data: database, cached images, DAT files.

Config.Name: IGDB Client ID
Config.Description: Twitch/IGDB API Client ID. Get one free at https://api.igdb.com

Config.Name: ROM Path (inside container)
Config.Description: Leave as /roms unless you changed the container path above.
